The '''Liberation of Syruss''' was a battle of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] that took place in the [[Syruss system/Legends|Syruss system]].

==The battle==
The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] launched a strike force against an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Space station/Legends|station]] in order to liberate the system. The Rebel strike force consisted of one [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] and two [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]]. In reaction, the Empire scrambled all of its available fighters, four [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] and two [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bombers]], to counter the attack. The two [[Snubfighter/Legends|snubfighter]] groups then engaged in a [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfight]].<ref name="Gamer 3" />
